svg.title: Icon and component library
svg.desc: Every icon is one symbol, instanced wherever it appears. Every repeated shape is one component, and a variation is a parameter rather than a second copy. Change one here and all fifteen drawings change with it.
svg.text: Every icon is one symbol, instanced wherever it appears. Every repeated shape is one component, and a variation is a parameter
rather than a second copy. Change one here and all fifteen drawings change with it.
THE ICON SET · 41 SYMBOLS ON A 32 GRID
A thing in the system: what it is, what it is for, and how far along it is. The icon is the colour of the kind of thing it is, so a column of cards can be read without
A tinted area with a solid tab on its edge. The tab names the zone, the tint says what kind of zone it is, and everything inside belongs to it.
One page of the site in the site map: two labelled chips, what the backend does, and what remains. Blue for a customer page, violet for a staff one.
No payment: the submit button is disabled on
One database table in the content model, with the fields another part of the system depends on.
The head of one lifeline in a sequence diagram, coloured by what kind of thing it is.
A soft aside: how to read a drawing, or the failure path beside the happy one.
Bad or missing captcha token: 400, nothing written.
Out of stock: the transaction rolls back, so no partial order.
Left to right. A dashed border means the thing does not exist yet.
